agreements: The v1a causal skeleton is worth preserving: public projection before model use; separate fallible same-model reflection; literal M0 plus matched OWN and DIST branches; prospectively fixed M1_OWN transport; a backend-neutral semantic/view/touch manifest; fresh donor/path/sham thinker runs; conditional exactly-two-adapter transport; and an unconditional human terminal.

The current bytes are not implementation-unique and are not releasable. Prompt warnings and generic schemas do not close model-visible free-text channels, provider-request variation, recurrence selection, provenance reduction, intervention choice, runtime variation, or candidate-menu confounding.

A green text bundle could support only a strongly frontier-scaffolded one-pair observation that this exact frozen prompted system constructed and used registered life-bound reader content. It cannot establish Paper-1 reliability, superiority, scale, beyond-context value, autonomous discovery, learned control, durability, action improvement, or a flywheel.

A green LoRA bundle could support only immediate per-life access to the registered cue rows and decision paths through the two exact fitted adapters. It cannot establish preservation of either whole corpus, longitudinal durability, capacity, or substrate superiority.

Same-model SELF_REVIEW_SAME_EVIDENCE is model-self-support from one evidentiary lineage, not verification or independent corroboration. False model-self-supported rows remain eligible and must not be truth-filtered.

The mandatory v1b closure is finite: M01 audit-only free text and closed model-visible row views; M02 exact provider-message, scratch, event/row, and recurrence bytes; M03 deterministic reducer, identity, duplicate, conflict, lineage, and depth rules; M04 monotone stage-local authority dependencies; M05 immutable development fixtures; M06 prospective path/sham manifests; M07 per-life LoRA metrics, matched candidate envelopes, and a full two-fit lock; M08 a resolved controller/runtime lock and receipts; M09 operational review independence and artifact inventories; M10 canary-only claim and validity language; and M11 removal of non-gating development arms from the mandatory minimum and recomputation of exact maxima.

Optional overengineering is not mandatory closure and is outside this successor: RAW_RAG and GOLD_OPEN_LOOP descriptive GPU cells, a general orchestration platform, a semantic truth checker, clean-base gating, replication, additional seeds or skins, RML, learned LOOP adapters, rank/model/prompt sweeps, long-context scaling, broader baselines, durability studies, publication actions, credentials, leases, or spend. Any later addition requires its own explicit authority and, when material, deliberation.

No consensus, reviewer, advocate, or result supplies human ratification. The current proposal, its implementation, every model/GPU call, seed-5 exposure, and both adapter fits remain forbidden unless a repaired byte-bound successor first completes deliberation and Rohin separately ratifies its exact bytes and scope.

disagreements.issue: Whether typed tuple fields and prompt prohibitions close answer-equivalent durable memory while DREAM and SELF_CHECK also emit arbitrary printable free text.

positions.position: The three dreamed tuple kinds and forbidden-row-shape rules keep final composition in THINK1, while prediction and reflection text remain ordinary immutable row or event metadata.

Arbitrary prediction, reason, and confidence material can carry labels, target-state conclusions, complete proofs, focus echoes, or action instructions because the reader and corpus views do not structurally exclude it.

resolution.rationale: The objection is decisive. A prompt cannot enforce a semantic denylist without recreating a truth-aware verifier, and the current full-row read exposes the channel directly.
resolution.selected_position: Keep all generated prediction, reason, and confidence material in a separate audit-only append stream. Model-visible and trained rows contain only kind, exact typed fields, provenance citations required by the closed algorithm, closed status/support metadata, and canonical identifiers; reader results and all four corpus views exclude audit text.
resolution.required_change: M01 mandatory bytes: revise DREAM/SELF_CHECK output-to-state mapping, memory-row/event schemas, reader response schema, all four view templates, compiler manifest, candidate construction, and LoRA training derivation so prediction/reason/confidence are audit-only and cannot affect semantic hashes or model requests. Add final-provider-message and durable-corpus mutation vectors for labels, mixtures, target conclusions, proof summaries, aliases, focus echoes, and action tokens in every free-text field. Do not add a semantic verifier.

disagreements.issue: Whether call counts, bounded-neighbor prose, stateless receipts, and operation schemas identify one provider-visible recurrent treatment.

positions.position: The fixed 46/22/16 schedules, six-row cap, prompts, and stateless-operation requirement adequately constrain implementation.

Message assembly, scratch evolution, prior-read rendering, call seeds, input limits, and complete ordered REACTIVATE/SLEEP/OWN/DIST context selection materially determine the produced corpus and remain unbound.
Canonical event-to-row and branch-local identities are also required to prevent citation collision and cross-life laundering.

resolution.rationale: Counts do not define the treatment. These choices affect visible evidence and state carryover, so they must be fixed before model use, but a canary-specific registry is sufficient.
resolution.selected_position: Bind one canonical operation-request registry and golden vectors for every phase, one finite scratch AST and deterministic reducer, one prior-read representation, one exact event/row namespace, and complete deterministic schedules/selectors for both lives and every branch.
resolution.required_change: M02 mandatory bytes: add canonical message roles/order and serialization, allowed-state schemas, scratch initial state/update/size rules, prior-read and NOT_FOUND/CONFLICT rendering, input/output ceilings, no-truncation and parse/terminal behavior, DREAM seed per opportunity, branch-qualified event/row IDs, exact witnessed mapping, and complete ordered WAKE/REACTIVATE/SLEEP/OWN/DIST context manifests or algorithms including balance, fewer-than-six, neighbor priority, and tie-break rules. P1CA02 must compare final provider messages plus parameters, not an intermediate object. No general controller framework is required.

disagreements.issue: Whether prose layered above permissive schemas uniquely defines SELF_CHECK compatibility, duplicate/status reduction, conflict equivalence, provenance, depth, and descendants.

positions.position: The execution-contract reducer, semantic-key deduplication, and lineage language are sufficient normative constraints over the generic schemas.

Schema-valid illegal verdict/support pairs, changed premise sets, duplicate semantic proposals, unqualified IDs, and undefined closure/conflict rules can produce different eligible corpora and interventions.
The repair must preserve model-self-support from the original unique evidence lineage and must not accidentally require independent evidence for every decisive join.

resolution.rationale: The systems defect is blocking, while the science qualification preserves the frozen no-verifier arm: same-lineage model self-support remains legal but is labeled honestly.
resolution.selected_position: Bind a finite compatibility and event table, deterministic first-create duplicate ownership with all later attempts audit-preserved, exact conflict equivalence, canonical namespaced IDs, and path-local acyclic provenance/depth closure. SUPPORTED may be SAME_EVIDENCE or INDEPENDENT only under their exact respective rules.
resolution.required_change: M03 mandatory bytes: define exact kind arities/atom namespaces; require SELF_CHECK premise_ids to equal the immutable CREATE citations; permit SUPPORTED only with SELF_REVIEW_SAME_EVIDENCE or INDEPENDENT_CORROBORATION, and CONTRADICTED/UNRESOLVED only with NONE; map each valid pair to one reducer event; make an invalid check consume its sole call and place the proposal in a named noneligible terminal state; allocate per-life/branch row and event IDs; make the first CREATE own a semantic tuple while preserving later duplicate attempts and verdicts audit-only; define conflict by one-null lookup key with multiple distinct returned-field values; define transitive public-lineage closure, independent-lineage criteria, depth as 1+max parent depth, descendant closure, shared-ancestor diamonds, and self/back-edge rejection. Bind canonical golden vectors for all cases.

disagreements.issue: Whether evidence marked required before a generic gpu_run can itself be produced by DEV_GOLD or later live stages without a cyclic or bypassable authority graph.

positions.position: The ordered authority list plus required_before metadata expresses the intended staged progression.
P1CA05 requires DEV model calls and complete P1CA09 ledgers require the calls they audit; a generic pre-GPU label is either impossible literally or permissive enough to bypass completed evidence.

resolution.rationale: The cycle is real and directly affects authorization. Evidence must be transition-local and hash-bound after the stage that produces it.
resolution.selected_position: Use explicit CPU-to-DEV, DEV-to-HELDOUT, HELDOUT-to-LORA, and LORA-to-terminal dependencies with separate stage-local accounting and review artifacts. Every forbidden, missing, rejected, invalid, or out-of-order transition terminates before dispatch.
resolution.required_change: M04 mandatory bytes: replace every generic required_before value with a machine-checked dependency table. CPU-only P1CA01-P1CA04 and P1CA06 preflight precede DEV_GOLD; DEV-local P1CA05 plus DEV instances of P1CA09/P1CA10 precede HELDOUT_TEXT; P1CA07 plus Stage-T P1CA09/P1CA10 precede CONDITIONAL_LORA; P1CA08 plus Stage-L P1CA09/P1CA10 precede terminal claim wording. Each token binds exact predecessor artifact hashes, partial-failure seal, validity class, and next-scope ceiling. HUMAN_TERMINAL is unconditional.

disagreements.issue: Whether P1CA05 freezes one development gate and whether non-gating RAW_RAG and GOLD_OPEN_LOOP deserve mandatory 32B calls in this minimum canary.

positions.position: NO_MEMORY, RAW_RAG, GOLD_TEXT, GOLD_OPEN_LOOP, and GOLD_TWIN should all run on seeds 0-2; the latter two descriptive arms are reported but never gate.
Majority calculation, all gold/RAG/open-loop fixtures, parsers, donor outputs, and edge masks are movable; the two non-gating descriptive arms add 144 operations without supporting an allowed claim.
Freeze the gate-bearing NO_MEMORY, GOLD_TEXT, and GOLD_TWIN cells and remove RAW_RAG/GOLD_OPEN_LOOP from this mandatory minimum; descriptive baseline work can be separately proposed later.

resolution.rationale: All gate-bearing fixtures must be immutable. Between the two legitimate cost choices, removal is selected because the current scope is a minimum existence/failure-localization canary, the extra arms are non-gating, and no existing directive authorizes avoidable descriptive GPU work.
resolution.selected_position: Retain only NO_MEMORY, GOLD_TEXT, and GOLD_TWIN as mandatory development model arms. Freeze their exact corpora, readers, messages, parsers, expected tokens, and necessary-edge masks; freeze all 31 shortcut predictors and one population-majority definition. RAW_RAG and GOLD_OPEN_LOOP are optional future work and cannot rescue or block this canary.
resolution.required_change: M05 mandatory bytes: bind the exact six development lives, global-development-label majority with the current lexical tie-break and heldout evaluation population, all 31 feature-subset lookup definitions/ties, individual and paired thresholds, all-predictors conjunction, NO_MEMORY requests, GOLD_TEXT/GOLD_TWIN rows and IDs, reader bytes, expected own/donor tokens, required-edge masks, parser/scorer vectors, attempt/stop rules, and post-DEV lock. M11 mandatory scope repair: delete RAW_RAG and GOLD_OPEN_LOOP from the v1b arm roster and requested mandatory work, remove their 144-operation allowance, and recompute every category and total ceiling from the surviving exact registry. Do not add a broader baseline study.

disagreements.issue: Whether path loss plus an implementation-selected matched sham supports path-specific use in the realized text runs.

positions.position: Removing the named role parent, descendants, and causal join, then removing an equal status/kind/token-mass nonpath set, is sufficient.
Undefined descendant closure, candidate protection, tokenizer, tolerance, priority, tie-break, and no-match behavior allow the harness to manufacture path loss or sham retention.

resolution.rationale: Both intervention readers must be determined without outcome access. The result is dependence on one registered multi-row reader-content removal in this realized run, not formal necessity or a population causal effect.
resolution.selected_position: After M1_OWN seals and the public final goal is revealed, but before any T-arm result is scored, compile and seal deterministic T-PATH and T-SHAM exclusion manifests using only the goal plus predeclared rules. Fail INVALID_PRECONDITION if no valid sham exists.
resolution.required_change: M06 mandatory bytes: reuse M03 descendant closure; define exact path roots and exclusion closure; define the sham candidate pool and protected set excluding path rows, descendants, alternate decisive rows, and all rows required by the registered own proof fixture; use the resolved controller tokenizer; match row count exactly and minimize a fixed lexicographic tuple of status mismatch, kind mismatch, absolute serialized-token-mass difference, then semantic hash; declare the allowed tolerance and INVALID_PRECONDITION on failure; hash both manifests before scoring; run fresh equal-envelope THINK1 calls. Claim only that this frozen reader-content intervention changed this pair's behavior when path loses and sham retains.

disagreements.issue: Whether pooled 96-case fidelity, per-life candidate menus, and a partial training recipe support a two-adapter content intervention.

positions.position: Pooled fidelity at least 0.90, paired L-OWN, exact L-TWIN tokens, and the stated rank/epoch/learning-rate recipe are sufficient for immediate accessibility.
Pooled scoring can hide one weak adapter; candidate roster changes can carry life identity; tie/scoring/cap rules and the complete fit are unbound, so adapter identity is not isolated.

resolution.rationale: The claim names two adapters, so each must clear its own fixed cues. The own/donor comparison must hold every request and candidate byte fixed except adapter identity.
resolution.selected_position: Require at least 44 correct of 48 frozen cues independently for each life, plus paired L-OWN and exact donor-valid L-TWIN behavior. Freeze one answer-preserving candidate and scoring protocol and one complete two-fit lock. A clean-base diagnostic is optional and non-gating.
resolution.required_change: M07 mandatory bytes: define candidate-value semantic hashes, cap-before-request rules that always retain the registered answer prospectively rather than insert it after outcomes, exact order, tokenization, candidate-logit scoring/normalization, ties, NOT_FOUND, malformed/conflict handling, and matched own/donor request envelopes whose only changed field is adapter identity. Bind optimizer, betas, epsilon, weight decay, scheduler, warmup, accumulation, shuffle/data/model seeds, packing, padding, loss mask, tokenizer/chat template, software/container versions, checkpoint selection, final-checkpoint hash derivation, mount/unmount, and failure policy. Report both 44/48 numerators. Limit language to registered cues and paths.

disagreements.issue: Whether repository revisions, dtype, temperatures, and aggregate ceilings identify the controller and adapter executions that would be scored.

positions.position: Pinned model repository revisions, decoding scalars, dtype, stateless receipts, and tokenizer-exact ledgers are an adequate runtime lock.

Tokenizer/chat-template artifacts, engine/container versions, numerical configuration, DREAM seeds, stop rules, context limits, and final provider-message hashes remain unspecified and can change results.

resolution.rationale: Exact scientific execution requires resolved artifacts and request parameters. Bitwise-identical GPU kernels are not required, but an unmatched declared lock or truncation invalidates the run.
resolution.selected_position: Bind resolved model/tokenizer/config/chat-template artifacts, inference and training runtime/container versions, all generation and numerical parameters, exact request hashes, and complete per-request receipts before any DEV call.
resolution.required_change: M08 mandatory bytes: add model and tokenizer file manifests with hashes, tokenizer revision, chat template bytes, inference/training engine and container lock, tensor parallel and numerical settings, context limit, padding/truncation policy, per-call seed, all sampling fields, stop strings/token IDs, stop/parse policy, candidate extraction version, and canonical final message plus parameter hashes. Extend receipts with these hashes, seed, exact input/output/candidate token counts, stop reason, parse result, and truncation=false. Any mismatch or truncation is INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE, consumes the attempt, receives no retry, and has no scientific interpretation.

disagreements.issue: Whether the words fresh independent reviewer and separate advocate define auditable transition authority and preserve reviewer supremacy.

positions.position: Fresh review and advocacy over one immutable lock before each transition adequately prevent self-certification.
Role overlap, fresh-context construction, artifact inventory, verdict schemas, missing evidence, advocate rejection, and supersession of rejection are not operationally defined.

resolution.rationale: The repository contract requires a genuine independent-review gate. Names without identity, scope, artifacts, and fail-closed verdict semantics do not implement that gate.
resolution.selected_position: Bind role/identity attestations, prohibit reviewer overlap with author/implementer/advocate for the reviewed lock, define fresh-context inputs and transition-specific artifact inventories, and require separate explicit reviewer and advocate dispositions. A rejection, invalid artifact, or missing item terminates; changed bytes require a new review.
resolution.required_change: M09 mandatory bytes: add reviewer and advocate schemas with identity/role attestations, reviewed lock and artifact hashes, supplied-context manifest, APPROVE/REJECT/INVALID verdict, reasons, and no-mutation receipt. Define exact mandatory artifact inventories for CPU-to-DEV, DEV-to-HELDOUT, HELDOUT-to-LORA, Stage-L terminal, and every earlier failure terminal. The independent reviewer cannot be an author, implementer, or advocate for that lock; the advocate cannot override reviewer rejection; later approval cannot supersede rejected bytes; any changed byte requires a new lock and reviews.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposed text, return, causal-use, LoRA-preservation, and negative-localization language stays within the registered observables.

positions.position: The canary can say it constructed and used connected memory, that goal-return caused useful extra construction under its conjuncts, that path pruning establishes causal use, and that the useful corpus remained accessible through LoRA.

The exact frontier is designer-supplied, path/sham manipulate a realized reader, DIST is one deterministic within-instance control, sampled cues do not represent a whole corpus, and red composite stages do not identify a unique failed organ.

resolution.rationale: The qualifications are necessary and do not weaken the canary's decision value. They prevent a one-pair, heavily scaffolded result from being promoted into the frozen Paper-1 claim.
resolution.selected_position: Use model-self-supported terminology; disclose the exact source/target frontier supplied to THINK0; describe path/sham only as a frozen reader-content intervention on this realized pair; award return-routing credit only when no-focus does not occur and the full M0/DIST/OWN/new-correct-used-row conjunction passes; limit LoRA to immediate registered-cue/path access; classify terminals as INVALID_PRECONDITION, INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE, VALID_STAGE_FAILURE, or VALID_STAGE_PASS.
resolution.required_change: M10 mandatory bytes: revise claim_delta, experiment text, evaluator disposition schema, artifact summaries, review rubric, and claim linter. A valid text pass says only that this exact strongly frontier-scaffolded prompted system constructed and used registered life-bound reader content on one pair. A valid return pass additionally requires T-OWN paired success, T-M0/T-DIST paired loss, no NO_FOCUS case, one OWN-only correctly typed model-self-supported focus-matching row, actual citation/use, donor tokens, path loss, and sham retention. A LoRA pass says only immediate per-life access for each adapter's registered cues and behavior path. Every red lists prompt/model/schedule/reducer/reader/runtime alternatives and never names a unique failed organ.

disagreements.issue: Whether repairing internal validity requires expanding the canary into a confirmatory Paper-1 program.

positions.position: The one aligned seed-5 pair is an appropriate existence/failure-localization canary once its internal validity is closed.
Replication, more skins/seeds, longer lifetimes, RML, stronger comparative baselines, learned LOOP control, sweeps, and durability would increase evidentiary breadth.
Those broader studies are required for the eventual headline but are distinct from and cannot be inferred from this canary.

resolution.rationale: Breadth does not repair the current visibility, treatment, or execution ambiguities. Expansion would multiply invalid cells and exceed the owner's design-discussion scope.
resolution.selected_position: Keep v1b to the same one-pair, text-first, conditional-two-adapter question and the finite M01-M11 closure list. Preserve every existing broader forbidden scope and require separate deliberation for any material extension.
resolution.required_change: Preserve in v1b the aligned development seeds 0-2 only for qualification, scored seed-5 latent twins as one unit, M1_OWN prospective transport, exactly two conditional rank-64 fits, and HUMAN_TERMINAL. Explicitly list all optional overengineering named in the agreements as forbidden/deferred. Do not add samples, models, ranks, prompts, retries, benchmarks, claims, external actions, or generalized infrastructure while applying M01-M11.
